# equinix_fabric_internet_access_services (Data Source)

Fabric V4 API compatible data resource that allows users to search for Equinix Internet Access (EIA) services with pagination details.

Additional Documentation:
* API: https://docs.equinix.com/api-catalog/fabricv4/#tag/Internet-Access-Services



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filter` (Attributes List) List of filter conditions (AND logic) for the Data Source Search Request (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))

### Optional

- `pagination` (Attributes) Pagination details for the returned Internet Access services list (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pagination))
- `sort` (Attributes) Sort criteria for the Data Source Search Request (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sort))

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) Returned list of Internet Access service objects (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `operator` (String) Operators to use on your filtered field with the values given. One of [ =, !=, >, >=, <, <=, BETWEEN, NOT BETWEEN, LIKE, NOT LIKE, IN, NOT IN, IS NOT NULL, IS NULL]
- `property` (String) Field name to use on filters
- `values` (List of String) The values that you want to apply the property+operator combination to in order to filter your data search


<a id="nestedatt--pagination"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pagination`

Optional:

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of search results returned per page. Number must be between 1 and 100, and the default is 20
- `offset` (Number) Index of the first item returned in the response. The default is 0

Read-Only:

- `next` (String) The URL relative to the next item in the response
- `previous` (String) The URL relative to the previous item in the response
- `total` (Number) The total number of Internet Access services available to the user making the request


<a id="nestedatt--sort"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sort`

Optional:

- `direction` (String) The sorting direction. Can be one of: [DESC, ASC], Defaults to DESC
- `property` (String) The property name to use in sorting. One of "/name" "/uuid" "/state" "/changeLog/createdDateTime" "/changeLog/updatedDateTime". Defaults to "/changeLog/updatedDateTime"


<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `account` (Attributes) Account details for the Internet Access service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--account))
- `bandwidth` (Number) Bandwidth of the service in Mbps
- `bandwidth_commit` (Number) Minimum bandwidth commit for burst billing variant of the service
- `billing` (Attributes) Billing details for the Internet Access service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--billing))
- `change` (Attributes) Current state of the latest change on the Internet Access service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--change))
- `change_log` (Attributes) Details of the last change on the Internet Access service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--change_log))
- `href` (String) Equinix auto generated URI to the Internet Access service resource
- `locations` (Attributes List) List of locations associated with the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--locations))
- `name` (String) Name of the Internet Access service
- `order` (Attributes) Order details for the Internet Access service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--order))
- `project` (Attributes) Project associated with the Internet Access service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--project))
- `routing_protocol` (Attributes) Routing protocol configuration for the Internet Access service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--routing_protocol))
- `state` (String) Provisioning state of the Internet Access service
- `type` (String) Type of the Internet Access service
- `use_case` (String) Use case of the Internet Access service. One of: MAIN, MANAGEMENT_ACCESS
- `uuid` (String) Equinix-assigned unique identifier for the Internet Access service

<a id="nestedatt--data--account"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.account`

Read-Only:

- `account_number` (String) Account number
- `href` (String) URI to the account resource

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether billing is enabled for the service
- `start_date` (String) Billing start date in RFC3339 format
- `type` (String) Billing type of the service


<a id="nestedatt--data--change"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.change`

Read-Only:

- `href` (String) Equinix auto generated URI to the change resource
